spec.description:
Autex Printed Lanes Baffle Sawtooth combines an asymmetrical directional
sawtooth profile with high-definition digital UV printing of natural timber and
stone textures. Engineered with an acoustic air cavity behind each 300mm wide
batten, it delivers class-leading acoustic absorption (NRC 0.85) alongside
striking shadow play and lifelike material aesthetics. It installs without glue
via a concealed clipping system, achieving Group 1 fire compliance and
carbon-neutral certification.
features:
Dynamic asymmetrical sawtooth
profile combined with digital timber or stone print finishes

Highest acoustic
performance in the Lanes collection achieving NRC 0.85

High-resolution
digital printing with safe, water-based UV-cured ink

Rear air gap cavity
enhances low and mid frequency sound absorption

Glue-free mechanical clipping
system ensures fast, clean, and mess-free installation

Lightweight,
seismic-safe alternative to solid timber or fluted stone battens

Constructed
from 100% polyester fibre with a minimum of 60% to 80% recycled PET

Group 1
fire rating compliant with AS ISO 9705 - 2003 and AS 5637.1

Modular 300mm
width sections available in 2400mm and 2700mm lengths

Certified Carbon
Neutral product with third-party verified EPD

install: Check wall substrate is plumb, flat, and dry

Inspect directional sawtooth
pattern and grain orientation prior to installation

Fix horizontal mounting
clips or channel track to framing studs at 300mm vertical centres

Snap the
printed folded Sawtooth lanes onto mounting clips firmly without adhesive

Ensure all panels are installed in a uniform directional orientation across the
wall

Trim bottom or top ends carefully using a fine-toothed saw on the offcut
side
selection_checklist:
Select print finish from Acoustic Timber
woodgrains or Surface Finishes palettes

Confirm wall height to choose 2400mm
or 2700mm lengths

Calculate wall width in 300mm increments (3 lanes per
pack)

Verify direction of light source to accentuate Sawtooth 3D printed
effect
Verify substrate framing supports mechanical clip mounting
limitations:
Indoor use only; avoid
wet areas or direct water exposure

Requires mechanical clip installation; do
not glue directly flat to wall

Directional profile must be installed in a
consistent orientation across the wall

use_cases:
Designing dramatic woodgrain acoustic feature walls with
directional lighting in corporate lobbies

Taming severe reverberation in
high-end conference suites with timber aesthetics

Acoustic feature walls in
luxury hospitality dining rooms, cocktail bars, and hotels
not_for:
Wet rooms
with direct running water
retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Printed Lanes Baffle
Sawtooth combines an asymmetrical directional sawtooth profile with
high-definition digital UV printing of natural timber and stone textures on 12mm
Cube polyester felt. Engineered with an acoustic air cavity behind each 300mm
wide batten, it achieves class-leading sound absorption (NRC 0.85) while
replicating architectural wood or fluted stone. Rated Group 1 fire compliant
under AS ISO 9705 and certified carbon neutral with over 60% recycled PET, it
provides dynamic architectural shadow play and superior acoustics for commercial
and institutional interiors.
